**The window opens on a short spine.** Columns 0 to 2, `cydC` to `infA`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 91 to 100% of them, fewest at column 1, `aat`, 91%.

A branch of 9 shell families runs through columns 40 to 48, [[phage tail]], carried by 15 to 26%.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 97 against 91%, and hesitates less there, 0.04 against 0.44 bits. Its most hesitant column, 49, `yliI`, is a variable column, at 1.07 bits.

**The window ends on fork columns.** Columns 76 to 78, `glnH` to `glnQ`, are [[glutamine transport]], carried by 44 to 35%. The last column is `ybiO`, in 30% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 91% of genes**, 0.43 bits on average, perplexity 1.6 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.58 against 0.17 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 96%.

label: cydC
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the cydC window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor cydC, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,816 to 2,895 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying cydC once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 91% of genes, 0.43 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,550 calls, named 97%, 0.15 bits; shell 8,378 calls, named 79%, 1.07 bits; cloud 1,032 calls, named 7%, 4.27 bits. Outside an RGP 35,078 calls, named 96%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 7,882 calls, named 71%, 1.58 bits. Columns: 3 spine, 35 fork, 42 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.58 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 96%); 7,882 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 49 (yliI, a variable column) 1.07 bits, RGP 30%; column 3 (clpA, a variable column) 0.95 bits, RGP 9%; column 71 (opgE, a variable column) 0.87 bits, RGP 27%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 3 spine columns: named 97%, 0.04 bits on average; the 77 fork and variable columns: named 91%, 0.44 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 49, is a variable column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-2 (3 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: cydC, aat, infA. named 91-100% (mean 97%), fewest named at column 1 (aat), named 91%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.11 bits (column 1 (aat)).
[S2] 2. columns 3-79 (77 columns) fork and variable columns: share 30-89%, 74 P, 3 S, RGP 6-37%. named 33-99% (mean 91%), fewest named at column 26, named 33%; most hesitant at column 49, 1.07 bits.
